Sync Create/Update processing uses common payload IDs. A recognized CalendarItem still has to satisfy each consumer contract; source alone does not prove a successful server fetch.",

Existing comments explain the reversed-sibling choice and top-level level calculation; no blanket cast, tree naming or comment template rule follows.
